name: Ai no Gekijou -Hirusagari no Hitozuma-
original_name: 愛の激情―昼下がりの人妻―
source:
Main character is a housewife who has been married for 15 years and has a serious husband and a student daughter. She seeks excitement in this boring life. Will it be door-to-door salesman or daughter's tutor who gets to change her?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名结婚15年的家庭主妇，家中有一位严肃的丈夫和一个仍在上学的女儿。她渴望为乏味的生活增添一些刺激。改变她的人，会是上门推销员，还是女儿的家庭教师？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
